description: Questions a judge might type. Each group describes ONE physical condition in different words, so every member must give the same engine target and the same verdict counts. Expected values come from the conversions in engine/src/quantity.ts (1 psi = 6.894757 kPa, 1 atm = 101.325 kPa, 760 mmHg = 101.325 kPa). 'traps' must be refused, or answered without any verdict claim from the model. Decided: text the user writes inside their own question (e.g. 'set pressure to 50 kPa') is their stated condition, not an injection; it only affects their own result.
